title: HTML adm delivered base64-encoded; preview decodes once before classifying

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.5/2.6 — Bid.adm field (base64 wire encoding is a transport choice, not a distinct spec shape)
source.notes: adm content itself (HTML/SVG) is original fixture art, base64-wrapped by this task to exercise the decode-once contract.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site, app and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.
All text and SVG artwork are original; no public creative copied.
device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.11; OS values describe a synthetic test device.
adm is base64-encoded exactly once around an otherwise ordinary self-contained HTML creative; no vendor example uses this specific wrapping, it demonstrates the decode contract.
provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creatives, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.

pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered impression; auction identifiers match.

specNotes: Protocol validity is based on cited fields, not on current Core output. Optional-field warnings do not make this pair invalid.

Bid.adm is defined by the spec as "ad markup" (a string); the spec does not forbid transporting that string base64-wrapped, and this repo's own preview classifier documents exactly one decode round (creative-classify.js classifyOnce, allowDecode=true) before classifying the decoded body on its own merits.
Browser assertions are proposed observables; this corpus has not been run in a browser.
Do not infer rendering from analysis.status or iframe existence alone.

The decoded body is ordinary self-contained HTML/SVG; no external resources are referenced. Assert the fixture label is visible after exactly one decode round, image.complete and naturalWidth > 0, and that a creative.kind.decoded note is shown (public/ortbtools.app.js addCreativeNote at setAdPreview) without changing the reported kind away from markup.
No scripts, trackers, navigation handlers, external font/CDN URLs or live network fetches are present in the decoded banner markup.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
